text:
logan: Quick idea — add a "sanity gate" in model admission that runs a compact perf + compatibility suite for quantized weights.

tara: +1. We keep admitting models that pass accuracy but then blow up perf once quantized.

aman: What would the suite measure? latency P95, memory, kv-cache compatibility?

logan: P95, tail latency, token throughput on small infra profile, and a binary pass/fail kv-cache compatibility check. Also check model.pb config vs runtime schema.

sylvia: We should keep it cheap — a microbench with 10 short inferences and 10 long ones. Use deterministic seeds. If it fails, the model goes to "needs manual review".

logan: Here's a draft config for the gate:

```yaml
admit_gate:
  tests:
    - name: latency_p95
      workload: mix_short_long
      limit_ms: 120
    - name: kv_cache_compat
      command: run_kv_check --model $MODEL
      expected: OK
    - name: memory_peak
      limit_mb: 16000
  infra_profile: small-gpu-1
  retries: 1
```

kevin: How do we handle different quantization schemes? int8 vs nf4? some fail only on int8.

logan: Good point. Gate should run on the quantized variant that would be used in prod by default, and also validate that a fallback path (FP16/FP32) exists and is tagged in metadata.

eval-bot: Added a quick benchmark job template: https://git.internal/redwood/bench/jobs/AdmitSanity. PR welcome :mechanical_arm:

tara: I'll prototype the microbench harness. Can we use the same seeds and prompts from the eval-suite so quality diffs are comparable?

sylvia: yes — reuse eval-suite prompts. Also capture generation hashes to detect silent tokenization regressions.

aman: Agreement: Add gate, microbench, reuse prompts, ensure fallback mapping. I'll own the infra bits.

logan: sweet. Who volunteers to write the RFC follow-up w/ rollout plan (canary + manual review flow)?

tara: I can write the RFC by EOW. I'll include APIs for model metadata tags and a UI column in Console.

logan: awesome. Moving to a tracking issue now: https://github.internal/redwood/issue/2345

kevin: FYI — we need to notify model providers about longer admission time for quantized paths. Might affect onboarding SLAs.

logan: noted. We'll add a note to onboarding doc + update the signup checklist. :thumbsup:
